achievements.name: Hooked
achievements.desc: Catch your very first fish, no matter how embarrassing it turns out to be.

achievements.name: Small Fry
achievements.desc: Catch 10 fish and start telling people you're 'into fishing now'.

achievements.name: Getting the Hang of It
achievements.desc: Catch 50 fish; your cast is starting to look almost intentional.

achievements.name: Century Cast
achievements.desc: Catch 100 fish and earn a firm nod from every dockhand on the isles.

achievements.name: Regular at the Water
achievements.desc: Catch 250 fish; the herons have started copying your technique.

achievements.name: Half a Thousand Tales
achievements.desc: Catch 500 fish, each one slightly bigger in the retelling.

achievements.name: One Thousand Splashes
achievements.desc: Catch 1,000 fish and become a local unit of measurement.

achievements.name: The Fish Fear You
achievements.desc: Catch 2,500 fish; word has gotten around beneath the waves.

achievements.name: Do You Even Sleep?
achievements.desc: Catch 5,000 fish, a number your friends describe as 'concerning'.

achievements.name: Ten Thousand Fathoms of Patience
achievements.desc: Catch 10,000 fish and pass quietly into shoreline folklore.

achievements.name: Starter Tank
achievements.desc: Catch 5 unique species; a collection is just a pile with ambition.

achievements.name: It Takes All Kinds
achievements.desc: Catch 10 unique species and start judging them by personality.

achievements.name: Curiosity Cabinet
achievements.desc: Catch 25 unique species, each stranger than the last.

achievements.name: Fifty Flavours of Fin
achievements.desc: Catch 50 unique species and correct strangers about all of them.

achievements.name: The Hundred Club
achievements.desc: Catch 100 unique species; the field journal is getting a second volume.

achievements.name: Serious Scholarship
achievements.desc: Catch 250 unique species and be cited in at least one lighthouse pamphlet.

achievements.name: Living Archive
achievements.desc: Catch 500 unique species; scholars now come to you.

achievements.name: One of Everything
achievements.desc: Catch 1,000 unique species and quietly complete the ocean.

achievements.name: A Cut Above
achievements.desc: Catch your first rare fish and feel the tug of destiny (and fish).

achievements.name: An Eye for Quality
achievements.desc: Catch 100 rare fish; at this point it's less luck and more lifestyle.

achievements.name: Purple Prose
achievements.desc: Catch your first epic fish and struggle to describe it without gesturing.

achievements.name: Taste for the Finer Fins
achievements.desc: Catch 50 epic fish, purely for the aesthetic.

achievements.name: Stuff of Legends
achievements.desc: Catch your first legendary fish; the water goes quiet when you walk by.

achievements.name: Legend Collector
achievements.desc: Catch 10 legendary fish, which is 10 more than most bards can claim.

achievements.name: Myth, Made Flesh
achievements.desc: Catch a mythic fish, then try to explain it to someone afterwards.

achievements.name: Thrice Beyond
achievements.desc: Catch three transcendent fish, as if one wasn't statistically offensive enough.

achievements.name: Big Fish, Small Pond
achievements.desc: Catch 10 unique species from the meadow ponds, frogs politely excluded.

achievements.name: Go With the Flow
achievements.desc: Catch 15 unique species from the rivers before they swim past you.

achievements.name: Lake Effect
achievements.desc: Catch 15 unique species from the lakes, where everything is calmer and deeper than it looks.

achievements.name: Coastal Curriculum
achievements.desc: Catch 20 unique species along the coast, tide schedule permitting.

achievements.name: Technicolor Census
achievements.desc: Catch 25 unique species from the coral reef, sorted roughly by rainbow.

achievements.name: Pressure Tested
achievements.desc: Catch 20 unique species from the deep sea, where sunlight is a rumour.

achievements.name: Eyes in the Dark
achievements.desc: Catch 12 unique species from the abyssal trench, where the fish look back.

achievements.name: Glow Getter
achievements.desc: Catch 12 unique species from the glowing caves; bring a lantern anyway, out of respect.

achievements.name: Down the Drain
achievements.desc: Catch 10 unique species from the city sewers and never quite recover socially.

achievements.name: Knee-Deep Research
achievements.desc: Catch 15 unique species from the swamps, boots optional but recommended.

achievements.name: Cold Case
achievements.desc: Catch 12 unique species from the glacier lakes before your fingers file a grievance.

achievements.name: Canal Connoisseur
achievements.desc: Catch 12 unique species from the harbor canals between passing gondolas.

achievements.name: Rust Belt
achievements.desc: Catch 10 unique species around the old oil rig, dodging drips the whole time.

achievements.name: Hot Water
achievements.desc: Catch 12 unique species from the volcanic hot springs; the fish arrive pre-poached.

achievements.name: Apprentice Angler
achievements.desc: Reach fishing level 10 and stop hooking your own hat.

achievements.name: Journeyfisher
achievements.desc: Reach fishing level 25; the guild starts remembering your name.

achievements.name: Halfway to Somewhere
achievements.desc: Reach fishing level 50 and develop opinions about knots.

achievements.name: Three-Quarter Time
achievements.desc: Reach fishing level 75, where the water starts telling you things.

achievements.name: The Big One-Oh-Oh
achievements.desc: Reach fishing level 100; fireworks are traditional but not included.

achievements.name: Overachiever
achievements.desc: Reach fishing level 150, well past where the manual stopped.

achievements.name: Beyond the Manual
achievements.desc: Reach fishing level 250 and start writing the manual instead.

achievements.name: Off the Charts
achievements.desc: Reach fishing level 500; cartographers have given up plotting your progress.

achievements.name: Unfathomable
achievements.desc: Reach fishing level 1,000, a number previously considered theoretical.

achievements.name: First Paycheck
achievements.desc: Earn 1,000 coins from fishing and immediately consider spending it on bait.

achievements.name: Comfortable
achievements.desc: Earn 100,000 coins; you now say 'market conditions' out loud, unprompted.

achievements.name: Fishillionaire
achievements.desc: Earn 1,000,000 coins and start signing things with a flourish.

achievements.name: Dragon's Hoard, But Damp
achievements.desc: Earn 100,000,000 coins, all of it smelling faintly of mackerel.

achievements.name: Bubbling Along
achievements.desc: Brew 10 potions with only minor discoloration of the ceiling.

achievements.name: Master of the Cauldron
achievements.desc: Brew 100 potions; the cauldron purrs when you approach.

achievements.name: Proper Kit
achievements.desc: Upgrade to a tier 3 rod and leave the driftwood stick behind.

achievements.name: Serious Hardware
achievements.desc: Upgrade to a tier 7 rod that hums quietly when the big ones are near.

achievements.name: The Final Rod
achievements.desc: Wield the tier 12 rod, the last one the smiths know how to make.

achievements.name: Restless Feet
achievements.desc: Visit 8 different zones; your boots are developing character.

achievements.name: Every Horizon
achievements.desc: Visit all 16 zones of the Driftwood Isles and run out of horizons to chase.

achievements.name: Grate Discovery
achievements.desc: Find the hidden entrance to the city sewers, and never speak of the smell again.

achievements.name: Let There Be Bio-Light
achievements.desc: Discover the glowing caves, where the walls have better lighting than most taverns.

achievements.name: Descent
achievements.desc: Descend into the abyssal trench and come back up slightly different.

achievements.name: Health and Safety Violation
achievements.desc: Set foot on the rusty oil rig without signing a single waiver.

achievements.name: Home Is Where You Moor It
achievements.desc: Place your floating island somewhere with a view.

achievements.name: Have Island, Will Travel
achievements.desc: Move your island to new waters, because the whole point of a floating home is the floating.

achievements.name: Green Thumb, Wet Hands
achievements.desc: Build a farm on your island and grow something that isn't seaweed.

achievements.name: Measure Twice, Cast Once
achievements.desc: Build a workshop on your island for all your tinkering needs.

achievements.name: Small-Batch Operation
achievements.desc: Build a brewery on your island; the bubbling is oddly soothing.

achievements.name: Small Offerings
achievements.desc: Build a shrine on your island and leave the sea something nice for once.

achievements.name: The Impossible Catch
achievements.desc: Catch a transcendent fish and briefly understand everything.

achievements.name: Night Shift
achievements.desc: Catch a fish at night, when the water keeps its best secrets.

achievements.name: Dawn Patrol
achievements.desc: Catch a fish at dawn, before the kettle has even boiled.

achievements.name: Ahoy There
achievements.desc: Send your first chat message; the isles are friendlier when you talk back.

achievements.name: Bag of Holding
achievements.desc: Fully upgrade your backpack until physics files a formal complaint.

achievements.name: The One That Didn't Get Away
achievements.desc: Catch the legendary whale that every dock in the isles claims to have seen once.

achievements.name: Fully Loaded
achievements.desc: Fill every attachment slot on your rod until it rattles pleasantly.

achievements.name: Down the Hatch
achievements.desc: Drink your first potion and hope the label was accurate.

achievements.name: Snap Streak
achievements.desc: Break your fishing line 10 times; somewhere below, the fish are keeping score.

achievements.name: Golden Hour
achievements.desc: Spend a full, cozy hour by the water doing absolutely nothing urgent.
